# #196 - Fyra köpråd mitt i AI-krisen

**Feed**: affarsvarlden-analys  
**Published**: 2026-11-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Affärsvärlden's analysts recorded this episode after a sharp sell-off: Nasdaq fell about 10% in a week and the broadest Stockholm index fell about 5%, driven by AI and data-center investment worries after the US midterms. The hosts did not buy the dip themselves. They went through five recent analyses and gave four buy recommendations: Hexatronic (upgraded from neutral), Tagmaster (buy kept after a large US acquisition), Nyab (infrastructure partnering model at about 10x) and Coor (upgraded after a Norwegian acquisition). Nordisk Bergteknik got a neutral rating because of high debt and a weak Q3. They were skeptical about the wave of serial-acquirer IPOs.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HTRO — Hexatronic | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Upgraded from neutral to buy. About 10x adjusted EBIT after the share fell, estimates rose and the company delivered a strong quarter.

#### Reasoning

The data-center unit (about 2 BSEK, around a quarter of sales) has grown organically more than 30%. The estimates already include the company's guidance that margins will normalise and assume weak European fiber, yet the multiple is still about 10x. Early signs of a Nordic fiber investment wave are not in the estimates, which gives extra upside. Risk/reward improved as the AI trade was shaken out.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the US data-center buildout slows (e.g. political curbs on data-center investment)
- if data-center margins fall more than guided
- if European fiber keeps deteriorating beyond the conservative estimates

> *"Givet förutsättningarna vi ser nu, så tycker jag att det här är en köpbarad aktie."*

---

### 🟢 TAGM-B — Tagmaster | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Buy kept after the 195 MSEK acquisition of Kapsch's tolling unit. Pro forma it trades at about 0.8x sales and 6x EBITDA.

#### Reasoning

Turnarounds of acquired units have lifted margins above 10% (EBITDA near 20%). The deal looks sensibly priced and the valuation stays low. Risks: a rights issue in early 2026 may weigh on the shares, technology shifts (sticker tags, AI cameras replacing magnetic sensors) are a threat, and sales are mostly new sales with little recurring revenue.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the rights issue is heavily dilutive or weighs on the price
- if sticker-type tolling tags displace Tagmaster's products
- if AI camera solutions replace magnetic traffic sensors
- if the acquired unit's profitability disappoints

> *"Vi behöll köprådet på den. Men man ska vara medveten om att det kommer en nyemission framöver."*

---

### 🟢 NYAB — Nyab | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Infrastructure partnering model at about 10x, strong order book (close to 900 MEUR), margin expected to rise. One of the episode's four buys.

#### Reasoning

The partnering model lowers project risk. There is a large pipeline in Norrland grid, rail (Uppsala tramway, Norrbotniabanan) and a Finnish data center. Margin should rise from 6.3% toward 7.4% by 2028 as the data-center project ramps up and legacy projects finish. Institutional ownership is low after the unusual route to listing (reverse merger, First North), so a re-rating is possible if funds build positions.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin expansion fails to materialise
- if project write-downs or disputes emerge
- if the staffing business keeps dragging on results

> *"Vi tycker att värderingen är attraktiv tio gånger. Vi tror att de kommer att växa mycket de kommande åren."*

---

### 🟡 NORB-B — Nordisk Bergteknik | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Neutral rating: debt too high, Grund Sverige lost money in Q3, and there is covenant and share-issue risk. Cheap if margins normalise.

#### Reasoning

Net debt of about 1.5 BSEK against a market cap of about 500 MSEK gives heavy leverage. The Q3 report erased earlier turnaround signs. Year-end goodwill impairments could breach the equity-ratio covenant and force a share issue. On the other hand, P/E would be under 5 if the whole group reached a 6% margin, and the machine fleet gives some floor. Analysts prefer stable balance sheets and passed on the stock for now.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a goodwill impairment triggers a covenant breach
- if a dilutive share issue is announced
- if Grund Sverige keeps losing money

> *"Därför satte vi ett neutralt råd på det här, inte ett säljråd."*

---

### 🟢 COOR — Coor | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Upgraded from neutral to buy after buying Insider Group in Norway for about 8x EBIT (about 5x with synergies) while Coor trades near 10x.

#### Reasoning

Scale in Norway could close part of the margin gap to Sweden (about 10% versus a group margin of 4-5%). The price is attractive and the synergies large, giving good conditions to grow profit next year. A possible bid from Visag is optional upside, not the thesis. Risk: a fifth of the target's profit comes from NOK, a small, fast-grown, project-driven construction-camp caterer with an 11% margin that may not last.

#### Sell Triggers

- if NOK's high margins collapse
- if synergies are not delivered
- if the Visag ownership situation leads to a dividend cut

> *"Den här affären fick oss att slå om rådet från neutralt till köp."*
